body: Fireguard run 2 (DM-198): `FIREGUARD_CONCURRENCY=2 FIREGUARD_BASE_REF=fd857e3d37c8ccc9d9ff21086dc203ac8fa5c685 npm run fireguard -- --json-out <tmp>/run2/fireguard.json --markdown-out <tmp>/run2/fireguard.md` on head 99d7f4c538ac9b4609958904f814fc73c2dbea8a. FIREGUARD_CONCURRENCY=2 (README speed knob, approved by the orchestrator) because at the default 5 lanes a flake run exceeded testTimeoutMs; thresholds, 100 flake runs and the run timeout unchanged. Ran 19:33:35Z-21:43:59Z (2 h 10 min). The flake gate completed (the mutation gate started ~21:20Z, which only happens after the flake gate passes; snapshot files began receiving mutants then). Result: NO GRADE - tool error exit 2 during the mutation gate: `vitest lane failed in ...\fireguard-aFanJz\lane-2: Error: vitest interrupted 3 runs in a row without a failing test` (fireguard/src/vitestLane.mjs:150). No report written. At 21:31Z the lanes were mutating src/core/plan/* modules. Diagnosing which mutant gives no verdict with Fireguard's own runMutationGate/openLanes (a driver outside the repo that logs each mutant run), modules from src/core/plan/ onward.
